claims.subject: Vulcain thrust-chamber validation
claims.object: 360 channels, aspect ratio 8.5 at the throat down to about 4.5, neither straight nor smooth
claims.statement: In the Vulcain test case (LOX/LH2, 100 bar, hydrogen coolant) the maximum channel aspect ratio is 8.5 at the throat and the minimum nearly 4.5, judged high enough to give confidence in the quasi-2-D predictions; the channels are neither straight nor smooth, which affects heat transfer and pressure drop.
qualifiers: hot gas by Bartz correlation, hydrogen by MBWR EOS, Colebrook friction, curvature by Niino
claims.quote: the cooling channel aspect ratio is high enough to give confidence in the predictions

claims.subject: Vulcain wall temperature and pressure drop
claims.object: maximum hot-gas-side wall temperature 850-900 K at the throat (data nearly 800 K) and coolant pressure drop 16.7 bar (PNS reference 16.2 bar); 1-D model 1300 K and 26.4 bar
claims.statement: The quasi-2-D model predicts maximum wall temperatures between 850 and 900 K in the throat region, in good agreement with Vulcain data where the maximum wall temperature is nearly 800 K, and a coolant pressure drop of 16.7 bar against 16.2 bar from a parabolized Navier-Stokes solver (3%); an equivalent 1-D model gives an unrealistic 1300 K and 26.4 bar.
qualifiers: the 'nearly 800 K' is a measured Vulcain maximum wall temperature, not a design allowable
claims.quote: the maximum values being located in the throat region and bounded between 850 K

claims.subject: quasi-2-D model validation
claims.object: good agreement with CFD for high-aspect-ratio channels and with Vulcain maximum wall temperature and pressure drop data
claims.statement: Pizzarelli et al. conclude that the model agrees well with CFD for high aspect ratio channels, because rib heat transfer and friction (2-D radial model) dominate the base contributions (less accurate 1-D model), and that it agrees with available Vulcain data.
claims.quote: good agreement of the quasi-2-D model with the reference solution in the case of high aspect ratio
